title: Classic Beef or Lamb Shepherd's Pie
ingredients: 1.5 lbs ground lamb or lean ground beef
2 tbsp tomato paste & 2 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
1 tsp fresh rosemary & 1 tsp fresh thyme, minced
2 lbs Yukon Gold potatoes, boiled and mashed with 3 tbsp butter, 1/3 cup warm milk, and 1/2 cup grated Parmesan/Cheddar
instructions: Preheat oven to 400°F (200°C). Boil Yukon Gold potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until tender, drain, and mash until smooth with butter, milk, and cheese.
Brown the ground lamb or beef in a cast-iron skillet or Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Add onion, carrots, celery, garlic, rosemary, and thyme; cook 6–8 minutes until softened.
Stir in tomato paste and flour, cook 1 minute, then deglaze with Worcestershire sauce and stock. Simmer 8 minutes until thick and glossy, then fold in peas and corn.
Spread the creamy mashed potatoes evenly over the meat filling, roughing the surface with a fork for crispy peaks. Bake 25 minutes (broil last 2 minutes) until golden brown.
